subject.title: Support Azure Foundry GPT Realtime Talk via gateway relay

question: Should the first landing path be API-key-only Azure Realtime over Gateway relay inside the OpenAI provider, with Entra/managed identity and an azure-openai alias deferred until live proof exists?
rationale: The remaining work controls where Azure credentials travel, how redirects or GA endpoints are handled, and whether OpenClaw exposes new provider/config surface, so automation should not choose that security/product boundary on its own.

options.title: API-key relay first
options.body: Implement the narrow gateway-relay Azure API-key path with strict Azure endpoint constraints, SecretRef docs, diagnostics, tests, and live proof; defer Entra and alias work.

options.title: Design Entra first
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define the permanent API-key, Entra, managed identity, and alias surface together.

options.title: Move to separate provider
options.body: Require a distinct Azure OpenAI realtime provider/plugin surface instead of extending the bundled OpenAI provider path.

recommendation.title: API-key relay first
recommendation.body: Implement the narrow gateway-relay Azure API-key path with strict Azure endpoint constraints, SecretRef docs, diagnostics, tests, and live proof; defer Entra and alias work.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent realtime voice bridge and Codex-auth work make this the strongest current owner signal for the provider/runtime direction.
